extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single leading label column (L=1); first data column is position 2 (V1) and the last data column is position 10 (V9). The right-hand 'Comment' column occupies source position 11 and is a notes column, not a schedule column, so no schedule_grid or activity_schedule entries are emitted for position 11; each non-empty Comment cell is emitted as an annotation instead. Column x-boundaries and every row band were recovered from the rendered page at 200 dpi (vertical rules at 71.8/251.8/296.6/323.8/350.6/377.6/404.6/431.6/458.6/485.6/512.5/738.0 pt, identical on all 7 pages); marks were then read from the pdftotext -bbox text layer by binning each token to its column band, and independently re-derived by counting near-black pixels in every row-band x column-band rectangle. The two methods agreed on every body cell (158 activity marks). Row boundaries were taken from the Comment column, not the activity-label column, because the CCI redaction bars fill the label cell edge to edge and read as horizontal rules there (they would have merged the two redacted rows on document page 23 into one). PDF pages 2, 5, 6 and 7 (document pages 18, 21, 22, 23) have a glyph-spread text layer (one glyph per token); activity names and annotation text on those pages were rebuilt from the glyph stream and verified against 200 dpi renders of the same cells. Hierarchy comes from bold + grey row shading, not from leading whitespace (every label cell starts at the same x), so indentation_method is font_signal throughout: the 8 grey-shaded bold band rows (Physical Evaluation, Patient Diary (Electronic), Patient-Reported Outcomes (Electronic), Clinician-Administered Questionnaires (Paper), Laboratory Tests and Sample Collections, Endoscopic Procedure, Stool Samples, Randomization and Dosing) are level 0 and carry no marks; their children are level 1. The 12 rows on document page 17 (Informed consent through Alcohol and caffeine use) precede the first section header and so are level 0 while carrying marks - they are top-level activities, not grouping headers. Three annotation containment pairs were re-verified against the page and are source-faithful, not split cells: c9 'See Section 8.2.2.' inside c8 (two separate Comment cells on document page 18), c10 'Locally performed.' inside c11 (document pages 18 and 19), and c16 inside c17 (serum pregnancy on document page 20, urine pregnancy on document page 21). c23 is one note cell printed identically beside two rows (PK samples and the redacted CCI row below it) on document page 22 and is emitted once with two marker_locations.

table_metadata.table_title: Table 1. Schedule of Activities for the Screening and Induction Treatment Periods of Study J1P-MC-KFAH
table_metadata.table_purpose: Anchor schedule for the Screening and Induction Treatment Periods: visits V1 through V9, weeks -5 to 12, study days 1 to 85, for all screened and randomized participants.
table_metadata.notes: table_type main_soa, per the agreed structure and confirmed on the page: this is the primary anchor grid (V1-V9) and it is the only table in the excerpt that prints no 'This schedule applies to...' population restriction - its header block carries only the V1/V9 multi-day note and two cross-references to Table 4. Nothing preceding it, so not continuation; no parent table shares its columns, so not domain; it is not finer-grained timing for another table's activity, so not subsidiary. Not tiled - a single column block continuing vertically over 7 pages, with the title, the three header-block notes and the 5 header rows (Visit number / Weeks from randomization / Study day / Visit interval tolerance (days) / Fasting visit) reprinted on each page and counted once. Six activity rows are redacted in the source to a black bar labelled 'CCI' (document page 18 between the symptom-directed exam and the ECG; page 21 between FSH and the TB test; page 22 after PK samples and after Genetics sample; and two rows on page 23 between C. difficile testing and the Randomization and Dosing band). All six still carry marks and are transcribed as activities named 'CCI'; the two on page 23 sit under ONE bar with 'CCI' printed once, so the second row's label cell has no text of its own - it is recorded with an empty cell_text and method visual_transcription rather than repaired. The abbreviations block printed under the table on document page 23 yields no annotations: none of its terms appears as a marker on a grid cell, a header cell or an activity label.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Visit identifiers for the screening and induction periods (V1 through V9); classified 'visit' because the row's values are named visit numbers.
Week number of each visit counted from randomization (–5 at screening, then —, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12); classified 'week' because the values are week numbers.
Protocol study day of each visit (—, 1, 8, 15, 29, 43, 57, 71, 85); classified 'study_day' because the values are numbered protocol days.
Allowable visit window in days (≤35 before V2 at screening, — at V2, ±3 for V3–V9); classified 'window' because the values are visit tolerances.

Grey-shaded qualifier band inside the repeated header block marking which visits are fasting visits (X at V2 and V9). Classified 'modality' because it qualifies the type/conduct of the visit rather than its timing; hierarchical_level null because the row does not itself tell one column from another - the visit/week/day rows already do - and it is not part of the timing hierarchy. It reprints on all 7 pages of the table and is counted once.
